items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Tad Jones with Tommy Ridgely. We're at his house... This is the third session.

ctx.x: Yeah, he wanted to talk about maybe we could go in there together.

This is the third session. Third session, right. The date's June 20th, 1986. Tad Jones with Tommy Ridgely. We're at his house on Arnold Avenue in River Ridge. So we're picking up from where we left off a month ago. Or wherever we were. Where we left off, we were talking about the last song we talked about was In the Same Old Way. That was where we left off. We were talking about that song. Okay.
In the Same Old Way. Yeah. Bring my memory back. Yeah. Okay, In the Same Old Way was written by Eddie Boe.
